stories.title: İtalya maçı öncesi... A Milli Takım'da 7 isim kadroda yer almadı

en.title: Before Italy match... 7 players excluded from A National Team squad
en.summary: Turkey's national football team will host Italy in a UEFA Nations League Group A match in Bursa. Seven players were not included in the 23-person squad for the match.

en.title: Embezzlement operation at Bolu Municipality! 9 detained
en.summary: A major operation was conducted regarding an embezzlement investigation involving the S.S. Köroğlu Local Products Cooperative and related companies under Bolu Municipality. Several individuals including the cooperative chairman were detained.

stories.title: Beylikdüzü’nde otopark kavgası silahlı çatışmaya döndü!

en.title: Parking lot dispute in Beylikdüzü turned into armed clash!
en.summary: A disagreement over vehicle parking in a residential complex parking lot in Beylikdüzü escalated into a physical altercation.

stories.title: İçişleri açıkladı: 'Siber suç' operasyonlarında 473 şüpheli yakalandı

en.title: Interior Ministry announced: 473 suspects caught in 'cybercrime' operations
en.summary: The Interior Ministry conducted operations across 25 provinces targeting qualified fraud, illegal betting, online child exploitation, and money laundering crimes. A total of 473 suspects were apprehended in operations over the past five days.

stories.title: Sosyal Demokrasi Derneği'nden Kılıçdaroğlu kararı: Üyelikten ihraç edildi

en.title: Social Democracy Association Expels Kılıçdaroğlu
en.summary: The Social Democracy Association decided to expel CHP leader Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu from membership. The association's chairman announced the expulsion decision.

stories.title: Sosyal Demokrasi Derneği'nden, Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu hakkında ihraç kararı

en.title: Social Democracy Association Expels Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu
en.summary: The Social Democracy Association expelled CHP leader Kemal Kılıçdaroğlu from membership due to statements and actions contrary to association principles. The board's honor council made the decision after investigation.

stories.title: Ankara'da spor salonu kavgası! 1 kişinin öldüğü silahlı çatışma kamerada

en.title: Armed Clash at Ankara Sports Hall Leaves 1 Dead
en.summary: A dispute over a sports facility ownership in Ankara's Çankaya district escalated into armed conflict between rival groups. One person died in the shooting incident, which was captured on camera.

stories.title: YENİ Parti, Ankara ilçe seçimlerini tamamladı

en.title: YENİ Party Completes Ankara District Elections
en.summary: The YENİ Party completed district chairmanship elections in Ankara. Members voted to select district leaders for the party's Ankara operations.

stories.title: Bolu Belediyesi'ne 'zimmet' soruşturması: Ev ve iş yerlerinde arama yapıldı, 9 kişi gözaltında

en.title: Embezzlement Investigation into Bolu Municipality: Raids Conducted, 9 Detained
en.summary: Turkish prosecutors investigating the Bolu Municipality conducted operations against cooperative managers and related businesses, resulting in nine detentions. Searches were carried out at the residences and workplaces of those detained.

stories.title: YENİ Parti'de ön seçim sonuçları belli oldu: Ankara'da 13 ilçe başkanı seçildi

en.title: YENİ Party Primary Results Announced: 13 District Chairs Elected in Ankara
en.summary: The YENİ Party held primary elections for district leadership positions across Turkey on September 26-27, with results now confirmed for Ankara. Party members voted to elect leaders for 13 districts in the capital.

stories.title: YENİ Parti’nin Ankara’daki 13 ilçe başkanı belli oldu

en.title: YENİ Party's 13 District Chairs in Ankara Determined
en.summary: The YENİ Party completed its primary elections for district leadership positions over the weekend, with members in Ankara voting to select chairs for 13 districts.

stories.title: SON DAKİKA! Fon soruşturmasında SPK’nın Başsavcılığa gönderdiği yazı ortaya çıktı! Tedbir kararı gerçek kişiler yönünden devam ediyor

en.title: BREAKING! Letter Sent by Capital Markets Board to Prosecutor's Office in Fund Investigation Revealed! Precautionary Measure Continues for Natural Persons
en.summary: In a fund investigation conducted by Istanbul prosecutors, a letter from the Capital Markets Board requesting reconsideration of legal measures against companies and funds has surfaced. Precautionary measures for natural persons remain in effect.

stories.title: Osmaniye’de okul bahçesinde silahlı saldırı: Öğretmen ağır yaralandı

en.title: Armed attack in school yard in Osmaniye: Teacher seriously wounded
en.summary: A person with prior disputes shot a teacher with a pistol at a school in Osmaniye. The seriously injured teacher was hospitalized and the suspect was arrested with the weapon.

stories.title: Güney Kore Türk İHA motoruna talip oldu

en.title: South Korea interested in Turkish UAV engine
en.summary: South Korea's Defense Acquisition Program Administration inquired about purchasing the PD170 engine from Turkey's TEI through TUSAŞ. The interest follows recent consecutive failures in South Korean drone tests.

stories.title: Türkiye Sinema Festivali’nde rekor: 2 günde 777 bin seyirci salonlara akın etti

en.title: Record attendance at Turkey Film Festival: 777,000 viewers in 2 days
en.summary: Turkey's Film Festival hosted 777,000 viewers across approximately 1,500 cinemas in 75 provinces on September 26-27. The Culture and Tourism Minister announced continued support for Turkish cinema.

stories.title: Petrolde tansiyon yükseldi: Fiyatlarda artış yüzde 3'ü aştı

en.title: Tension in oil rises: Price increase exceeds 3 percent
en.summary: Rising tension between the United States and Iran moved oil markets as Iran announced no new negotiations with Washington. Brent crude rose 3.5 percent to 100.84 dollars.

stories.title: Turizmde dünya sıralaması değişti Japonya zirveye çıktı

en.title: Global tourism rankings shift as Japan reaches top position
en.summary: Japan topped the World Economic Forum's 2026 tourism index, with European countries maintaining strong positions in the top 10. Albania showed the fastest growth, while Turkey was highlighted as a special example for sustainable tourism practices.
